author: Minecraft
description:
It’s here - Minecraft has arrived on Nintendo Switch™ 2!

Dig into your dazzling adventure with integrated Vibrant Visuals* support - including the Nintendo exclusive Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack and other Vibrant Visuals* enabled content across Minecraft Marketplace! Choose from the digital Standard Edition, Deluxe Collection or Ultimate Collection – or the physical Minecraft Standard Edition at retail.

Already own a digital or physical version of Minecraft for Nintendo Switch™? Upgrade paths are available**! Carry over your Nintendo Switch™ worlds to Nintendo Switch 2* and pick up where you left off, or play anywhere.

*Vibrant Visuals not available in some gameplay, including split-screen and when using certain Marketplace Worlds and content.

**For upgrade details, learn more at minecraft.net/article/play-minecraft-on-nintendo-switch-2
title: Minecraft on Nintendo Switch™ 2!
